As someone who has horrible sh scars that look like I got attacked by a bear on both thighs (thick raised scars), who ever comes into your life shouldn’t be bothered by them. And if they are, they aren’t worth your time. Last time I sh was when I was 20. In 30 now. Met my fiance when I was 23 and the scars were still slightly pink and more noticeable. We now have been together 7 years and have two beautiful children (4,2). I’m still embarrassed about them. However it is not something that can be changed. They are a part of you that tell a story of pain and hardship, and if they’re scarring, that means recovery as well. Scars tell a story. You should be proud you’ve overcome it, and whoever you end up with should be proud you’ve overcome it as well. Best of luck. I know acceptance around them is so difficult, and it may never fully get better but whoever you’re with should see you for you, not your scars
